description.text: Education Objectives: The Objectives are to help the students to learn the basics, to lay a good foundation for international students who are going to pursue academic qualifications in China, and to successfully adept into Chinese life, to promote education, technology and cultural exchanges between China and other countries, and enhance friendship It is an alternative pathway to pursue undergraduate degrees for the students who are disadvantaged by their geographical location, family situation, education background or other circumstances. Core Subjects: 1) English Fundamentals 2) Chinese Culture and Introduction to China 3) Mathematics 4) IT Essentials (Lab and Course Work) 5) Physics/ Economics Enrollment Scale: Small classes: less than 15 students per class(including 15) Large classes: 16-30 students per class (including 16) One-to- one classes: 1-2 students per class Schedule: 16-20 classes per week(a class: 40 minutes) Why Choose Foundation 1.A stepping-stone to top universities For poor-grade students, through the full-time study in foundation course, they can improve their abilities in Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing, English and mathematics, and finally achieve the entry level of Bachelor`s programs offered in Chinese at UIBE. 2.Time Saving Without waiting for 2 years to get an A Level, O Level Students can apply Bachelor`s programs offered in Chinese at UIBE after our foundation course. Why Study in UIBE 1.Top-ranked University in the world UIBE is a famous national university under the leadership of the Ministry of Education, and is also a member of "Project 211", which is a governmental project aiming at turning about 100 Chinese universities into high quality academic institutions in the 21st century. 2.Excellent geographical location Located in Beijing, UIBE is situated in the northeastern part of the capital city, enjoying pretty convenient public transportation services. 3.Promising employment prospect As always, UIBE students are widely welcomed by society for their sound professional knowledge and skills, strong linguistic ability, active thinking and rich practical experience. UIBE graduates have been mainly employed in governmental institutions, financial factors, multinational corporations and commercial institutions stationed abroad. Besides, UIBE places great importance on helping students to find work experience and career opportunities. 4.High quality education With a galaxy of talents, UIBE has attracts the best minds and brings up famous personnel generation after generation. Most professors have oversea experience and the strong abilities of teaching and researching, which enable them to rank among the National Talent Cultivation Project. 5.World recognized Business Studies UIBE is the top university in the fields of economics and business. It offers almost 40 majors to overseas students for bachelors, masters and PhD level in the fields of economics, management, liberal arts, law, science, and international trade, finance, business management, and foreign languages. 6.Diversified international students UIBE has a total enrollment of over 16,000 full-time schooling students including more than 3,200 international students from over 130 countries. It is the most popular university among overseas students. 7.Elite Alumni Group UIBE alumni include lawyers of world-class law firms, legal counsels of multinational corporations and non-profit organizations, government officials at all levels, as well as scholars in academia.

duration.text: The Foundation Course for Bachelor’s Programs-Science at Belt and Road Collaborative Innovation College is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3097 USD/per year ￥ 22300 CNY/per year

requirements.text: Age Requirements: Basic classes of bachelor degree(18-25 years old), postgraduate basic classes (26-35 years old), adult basic classes (18-60 years old).
